page.title: Clash 代理守卫
page.subtitle: 三段式开关 + 全链路加固 + 泄漏审计。渗透测试时开全局，保证本机所有出站流量走代理，不暴露真实 IP。
page.loading: 正在读取 Clash 状态…
page.sectionModeNote: 全局会同时开启 TUN、严格路由、系统代理、DNS 劫持，断开旧连接，并关断物理网卡 IPv6。关闭会把上面这些系统改动按基线精确回滚。
page.sectionAuditNote: 每一条都是可判定的事实。红色项意味着真实 IP 可能正在暴露。
page.sectionNodesNote: 全局模式下，这一组的选择决定所有流量走哪个节点。直连/拒绝类节点已过滤。
page.sectionSettingsNote: 这些开关只影响「全局」档位执行哪些加固动作。关掉某一项就是主动接受那一条泄漏面。
page.elevatedNo: 未获得（部分加固项会失败）
page.toggleStrictRoute: 强制 TUN 严格路由（堵住绑物理网卡的应用）
page.toggleSystemProxy: 同时开 WinINET 系统代理
page.toggleWinHttp: 同时设置 WinHTTP 代理
page.togglePointDns: 物理网卡 DNS 指向 TUN 网关
page.toggleAutoDoh: 关闭 DoH 自动升级
page.toggleCloseConnections: 切换时断开全部旧连接
page.sectionKernelNote: 内核由 Windows 服务守护，GUI 只是前端。关掉 Clash Verge 窗口不影响这里；内核不在时插件可以自己把它拉起来。
page.independentNote: 不依赖 GUI：实测关闭 clash-verge.exe 后内核与管道照常存活、照常可控。
page.severityHint: 这条一旦失败有多要紧
page.healHint: DNS 指向死隧道地址或代理指向死端口时，一键恢复上网

indicator.label: 出口 IP
indicator.tipChecking: 正在检测整机出口（系统 / 代理 / 绑卡三条路径）…
indicator.tipMasked: 三条路径都被遮住，外面看到的是代理 IP，不是本机真 IP。
indicator.tipExposed: 本机真实 IP {real} 正在暴露 —— 至少一条出网路径直接用了它。
indicator.tipBypassable: 绑物理网卡能直接出网（{bound}），虽然当前拿到的不是真 IP，但这条路随时会被绑卡程序走通。
indicator.tipUncalibrated: 尚未校准真 IP，无法判断是否暴露。在「关闭」档位点一次「校准真 IP」。
indicator.tipUnreachable: Clash 控制器不可达，代理出口测不了。
indicator.tipNoEgress: 三条路径都取不到出口 IP。
indicator.tipSystemOnly: Clash 控制器不可达，但系统出口仍可用（{system}）。

page.title: Clash Proxy Guard
page.subtitle: Three-way switch + full-stack hardening + leak audit. Turn on Global before penetration work so no outbound traffic exposes the real IP.
page.sectionModeNote: Global also turns on TUN, strict-route, the system proxy and DNS hijack, drops stale connections, and turns off physical-NIC IPv6. Off rolls every one of those system changes back to the recorded baseline.
page.sectionAuditNote: Every row is a decidable fact. A red row means the real IP may be exposed.
page.sectionNodesNote: In global mode this group decides which node every packet uses. Direct/reject entries are filtered out.
page.sectionSettingsNote: These only affect what the Global switch enforces. Turning one off means accepting that leak surface.
page.elevatedNo: not granted (some hardening steps will fail)
page.nodesIdle: Press Refresh to load the node list
page.toggleStrictRoute: Force TUN strict-route (blocks apps bound to the physical NIC)
page.toggleSystemProxy: Also set the WinINET system proxy
page.togglePointDns: Point physical-NIC DNS at the TUN gateway
page.toggleCloseConnections: Drop all stale connections when switching
page.sectionKernelNote: The kernel is supervised by a Windows service; the GUI is only a front end. Closing the Clash Verge window changes nothing here, and the plugin can start the kernel itself.
page.independentNote: GUI-independent: with clash-verge.exe closed, the kernel and its pipe stay alive and controllable.
page.severityHint: How much this check matters when it fails
page.healHint: Fix DNS pointing to a dead tunnel or a dead proxy port, restore connectivity

indicator.label: Egress IP
indicator.tipChecking: Checking the machine egress (system / proxy / bound-interface)…
indicator.tipMasked: All three paths are masked; the outside world sees the proxy IP, not this machine.
indicator.tipExposed: The real IP {real} is exposed — at least one egress path used it directly.
indicator.tipBypassable: Binding the physical NIC reaches the internet ({bound}). It is not the real IP right now, but any interface-bound program can take that path.
indicator.tipUncalibrated: The real IP is not calibrated, so exposure cannot be judged. Switch to Off and calibrate once.
indicator.tipUnreachable: The Clash controller is unreachable; the proxy egress cannot be measured.
indicator.tipNoEgress: None of the three paths returned an egress IP.
indicator.tipSystemOnly: The Clash controller is unreachable, but the system egress still works ({system}).
